item.title: Hiyajiru: Miyazaki's Cold Soup — Guide
item.description: Hiyajiru (‘cold soup’) is Miyazaki’s traditional summer comfort food, a refreshing and nutritious dish perfectly suited to the prefecture’s hot, humid climate. It’s made from a chilled broth of miso blended with grilled and ground fish (often flying fish or aji), toasted sesame and dashi, seasoned and thinned with cold water into a savoury, nutty, umami-rich soup. This is then poured over a bowl of rice and topped with cool ingredients like sliced cucumber, shiso leaf, myoga ginger and tofu.
